title: roadmap.sh
description: Community-driven visual roadmaps, study plans, and interactive guides for Frontend, Backend, DevOps, AI Engineer, Full Stack, and Cybersecurity career paths.

title: DeepLearning.AI
description: Founded by Andrew Ng, offering premier short courses and deep specializations on Generative AI, LLM Application Engineering, RAG Systems, and AI Agent Architecture.

title: NeetCode
description: Structured algorithmic problem solving and coding interview preparation platform featuring video explanations for the Blind 75 and NeetCode 150 challenges.

title: Full Stack Open (University of Helsinki)
description: Comprehensive, modern full-stack web development course covering React, Redux, Node.js, REST APIs, GraphQL, TypeScript, React Native, CI/CD, and Containers.

title: Fast.ai (Practical Deep Learning)
description: Top-down practical deep learning course for coders. Learn PyTorch, computer vision, natural language processing, and diffusion models from first principles.

title: Prompt Engineering Guide (DAIR.AI)
description: The definitive open-source guide and research paper hub on prompt engineering, context management, multi-agent frameworks, chain-of-thought, and LLM evaluation.

title: ByteByteGo (System Design)
description: Illustrated software architecture and system design guides by Alex Xu covering high-scalability systems, microservices, caching, rate limiters, and distributed databases.

title: Scrimba
description: Interactive coding school where you can pause any video tutorial and edit the code directly in the screencast player to learn frontend frameworks and UI styling.

title: NPTEL
description: NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning) is an Indian online learning platform offering courses from top IITs and IISc. Features video lectures, assignments, and certifications. Covers engineering, science, and humanities subjects.

title: AWS Skill Builder
description: AWS Skill Builder is Amazon's official learning platform for cloud computing. Features hands-on labs, digital training, and certification preparation. Offers courses on AWS services, cloud architecture, and solutions.

title: InterviewBit
description: InterviewBit is a platform for coding interview preparation. Features practice problems, mock interviews, and company-specific questions. Helps developers prepare for technical interviews at top tech companies.

title: StackUp
description: StackUp is a learning platform that rewards users for completing educational tasks and courses. Features gamified learning, skill tracking, and rewards for achievements. Makes learning engaging through incentives and progress tracking.

title: JavaScript.info
description: JavaScript.info is a comprehensive modern JavaScript tutorial covering everything from basics to advanced topics. Features interactive examples, clear explanations, and up-to-date content. Perfect for learning JavaScript from scratch or deepening your knowledge.

title: Scaler

title: ACI Learning
description: ACI Learning provides cybersecurity training and IT skill development through hands-on labs, videos, and practice exams. Features certification prep for CompTIA, CEH, and CISA. Offers personalized learning paths and real-world simulations for IT professionals.

title: Microsoft Learn
description: Microsoft Learn provides free, interactive training for Microsoft technologies and platforms. Features hands-on learning paths, modules, and certifications. Perfect for developers working with Azure, .NET, and Microsoft cloud technologies.

title: Google Career Certificates
description: Google Career Certificates provide professional training in high-demand fields. Features hands-on projects, expert instructors, and job-ready skills. Programs include Data Analytics, IT Support, UX Design, and more with potential for career advancement.

title: Stanford Online

title: MIT OpenCourseWare

title: CS50's Web Programming
description: CS50's Web Programming course from Harvard University. Features comprehensive coverage of web technologies, practical projects, and problem sets. Taught by David Malan, this course provides a solid foundation in modern web development.

title: The Odin Project

title: Fullstack Open

title: fast.ai
description: fast.ai provides practical deep learning courses that make AI accessible to everyone. Features cutting-edge research, practical coding lessons, and a supportive community. Known for making complex AI concepts simple and approachable.

title: Coursera
description: Coursera partners with top universities and companies to offer online courses, specializations, and degrees. Features include video lectures, peer-reviewed assignments, certificates, and full degree programs. Courses from Stanford, Yale, Google, IBM, and more. Free audit option available, paid certificates, and subscription plans. Covers technology, business, data science, arts, and more. Perfect for professional development and academic learning.

Great for beginners with its interactive approach. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL, and many other languages.
